timestamp_convention: Explicit UTC ISO-8601; sale_date is UTC payment date for noncancelled lines
null_policy: All fields required; only paid_at and fulfilled_at may be null; CSV empty means null
schema_evolution: Unknown additive fields retained; incompatible types/missing fields quarantined; unsupported schema versions rejected

line_id.description: Stable unique synthetic order line ID

order_id.description: Synthetic order ID; lifecycle/location consistent across its lines

sale_date.description: UTC date to which revenue and attributable refunds belong

quantity.description: Positive units on line; quantity times unit price must also fit bigint

discount_cents.description: Total discount for line, at most quantity times unit price

status.description: Current source lifecycle status; cancelled lines contribute no revenue

fulfilled_at.description: Fulfillment timestamp; mandatory only for fulfilled and not before paid_at

version.description: Monotonically increasing correction version per line_id
